messages:
olivia: Kicking off prod deploy for v1.14.0-rc3 -> v1.14.0 now. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Deploy ID deploy-2026-03-20-01. Watch migration jobs; will call if we need to pause.

deploybot: [deploy-2026-03-20-01] STARTED · env=prod-us-west-2 · commit=7f3a2b4 · tag=v1.14.0-rc3 · initiator=olivia

deploybot: Migration jobs queued:
```
- schema_migrate (concurrent_index, backfill)
- vacuum_analyze (post-migrate)
- add_index_nonblocking (deferred)
```

raj: Quick q — which shard does schema_migrate hit first? any long exclusive DDLs? @olivia

sam: Canary to prod-staging was clean. Order: schema_migrate runs on shard-3 first (backfill of users.email_default), it's mostly UPDATE in batches. Expect ~5-12m for shard-3, no exclusive locks planned but the ALTER with default does a backfill we watch closely.

deploybot: [job-9872] schema_migrate STARTED on db-prod-shard-3 · pid=32211 · SQL: `ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN email_default boolean DEFAULT false`

infra-bot: Observability: brief lock on users table observed at 01:02:14 UTC, duration=12s, waits spike ~0.4s avg across app p99. Not seeing connection queueing yet.

tess: Heads up — vacuum job auto-triggered while backfill still running, disk IO on db-prod-1 spiked to 78% — could push latency. Recommend throttling workers or pausing vacuum.

olivia: @deploybot please throttle schema_migrate concurrency=2 and pause vacuum_analyze for now.

deploybot: Acknowledged. Applied: schema_migrate concurrency=2 to job-9872. vacuum_analyze set to HOLD.

deploybot: [job-9872] schema_migrate FINISHED on db-prod-shard-3 · rows_backfilled=1,242,183 · runtime=00:07:24 · status=SUCCESS

deploybot: [job-9901] vacuum_analyze FAILED on db-prod-1 · error=OOM while workers=8 
```
stack: psql: could not allocate memory
```

maria: OOM on vacuum is annoying — can we skip vacuum for this deploy and schedule a maintenance re-run tonight? Risk of skipping is temporary bloat but low immediate risk.

raj: +1 to skip. We can re-run with parallelism=2 in off-hours.

olivia: Decision: skip vacuum now, continue deploy. Pin prod runtime to tag v1.14.0-rc3 -> promoted v1.14.0. I'll open ticket INFRA-5423 to re-run vacuum with low workers at 23:00 UTC.

deploybot: [deploy-2026-03-20-01] FINISHED · env=prod-us-west-2 · release=v1.14.0 · rollback=false 
Summary: migrations applied: schema_migrate (shard-3 success). add_index_nonblocking: queued (deferred). vacuum_analyze: skipped (manual rerun INFRA-5423). Links: https://runbook.internal/releases/v1.14.0-notes, https://observability.internal/runs/deploy-2026-03-20-01

maria: Nice. I'll take INFRA-5423 and coordinate the low-IO vacuum run. :thumbsup:
